title: Bisu Bisu no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + rock-hard packed biscuits as the peak (no stages and no awakening)
facts: Appearance: not revealed (plain swirl fruit stands in)
Paramecia, Bis-Bis Fruit: create and shape biscuits
Biscuits hard enough to block attacks; biscuit soldiers in effectively endless numbers
Cracker hides inside a biscuit soldier and fights from within
Packing more layers makes the biscuits harder
Biscuits soften and crumble when wet (Nami's rain)
Charlotte Cracker, Big Mom's son; fought Luffy for 11 hours; Luffy ate the biscuits

plan.fruit: The fruit's appearance **has never been revealed**, so a plain round swirl fruit in biscuit orange stands in (no face or limbs). (A fan role-play wiki describes it as golden-brown; that is not canon.)
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a ninja in a black hood and face mask.

**Charlotte Cracker (matched to your reference):** purple hair with two long coiled tails, scar over the eye, big toothy grin, shirtless, brown gloves, pink dotted side cape with a pink-and-gold shoulder pad, pink belt with gold rings and lumpy biscuits hanging from it, puffy white-pink-green ball pants, purple drape, brown boots with yellow bands.
**Luffy:** straw hat, red open vest, blue shorts, scar under his eye.
**Biscuit soldiers:** built from the same lumpy golden biscuits with dots as on Cracker's belt, with a biscuit shield and a spear.
plan.sets: bakery, tan rays, giant cookie jar, glowing brick oven, cake-tier stage, candy town, castle parade ground, candy-castle hall, blacksmith forge, rainy café window, rainy town square, forest with a giant biscuit wall, supermarket snack aisle.
